task.description:
WF-05 Step 1 (v3): Execute the SwiftRoute tenant onboarding UAT scenario through the GUI. All three fixes are now merged to main:
- ISS-0069: navigateSpa page.goto fix
- ISS-0070: saga schema-qualification fix
- ISS-0071 Fix A: ONBOARDING_PIPELINE_SLUG env var injection
- ISS-0071 Fix B: realm-existence guard in GET /api/v1/onboarding/:id
- TD-UI-01/02/03: per-tenant dashboard and identity indicator

Scenario: tests/simulation/scenarios/swiftroute-tenant-onboarding-happy.yaml
Pipeline test: web/tests/e2e/pipelines/onboarding-wizard.pipeline.e2e.spec.ts
Backend: http://127.0.0.1:8080 (bpm_dev, port 5432)
Keycloak: http://localhost:8081

GUI-ONLY RULE: Every process step through Playwright. No direct API calls for scenario steps.

Pre-flight (allowed as infrastructure checks):
1. GET http://127.0.0.1:8080/health/ready → 200
2. GET http://localhost:8081/health/ready → 200
3. psycopg2 to bpm_dev: SELECT count(*) FROM public.tenant WHERE slug='swiftroute' → must be 0
If any fails: STOP BLOCKER.

Setup (allowed as setup, not process steps):
- Set ONBOARDING_PIPELINE_SLUG=swiftroute and ONBOARDING_PIPELINE_ADMIN_USERNAME=alice.bauer before running the pipeline test (ISS-0071 Fix A)

Process execution (Playwright only):
  cd web
  $env:BPM_TEST_URL='http://127.0.0.1:8080'
  $env:BPM_IDP_BASE_URL='http://localhost:8081'
  $env:ONBOARDING_PIPELINE_SLUG='swiftroute'
  $env:ONBOARDING_PIPELINE_ADMIN_USERNAME='alice.bauer'
  npx playwright test pipelines/onboarding-wizard.pipeline.e2e.spec.ts --reporter=json *> ../scratch/playwright-onboarding-v3.json

After pipeline test: check if swiftroute Keycloak realm exists (setup check):
  GET http://localhost:8081/admin/realms/swiftroute (admin-cli token)
If realm exists: reset Alice's password via Keycloak admin API (setup only, not process step):
  PUT /admin/realms/swiftroute/users/{alice_id}/reset-password {type:password, value:alice-pass-001, temporary:false}

Steps 4-5 via Playwright:
  - Navigate to http://localhost:8081/realms/swiftroute/account in a new page, log in as alice.bauer/alice-pass-001, screenshot
  - Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8080 in a new page logged in with alice's token, screenshot the dashboard
  - Verify data-testid='tenant-display-name' shows 'SwiftRoute Ltd' on screen (TD-UI-02)

Expected outcome changes vs v2:
  EO-001: result screen shows slug='swiftroute' (not pl-<uuid> — fixed by ISS-0071 Fix A)
  EO-002: progress screen (unchanged)
  EO-003: Alice logs in to swiftroute realm (realm exists — fixed by ISS-0070)
  EO-004: dashboard shows 'SwiftRoute Ltd' in TenantHeader (fixed by TD-UI-01/02)

Write UAT report: tests/uat-reports/uat-2026-06-16-WF05-swiftroute-onboarding-gui-v3.yaml
Business language only. Primary evidence: screenshots and what the screen showed.

PASS criteria: all 4 EOs pass with screenshot evidence.
If any EO cannot be verified via screen: FAIL with suggested_action.
acceptance_criteria: EO-001: result screen shows slug='swiftroute' and success message
EO-002: progress screen with spinner visible
EO-003: Alice login screenshot shows logged-in state in swiftroute realm
EO-004: dashboard screenshot shows SwiftRoute Ltd in TenantHeader
